edges.reason: ArcxToken.transferFrom applies the checkBots modifier.
checkBots performs the low-level call to botProtection.
botProtection state variable is the call target.
_from is encoded into the bot protection calldata.
_to is encoded into the bot protection calldata.
_value is encoded into the bot protection calldata.
notABot receives the call success flag.
isNotBot receives the call return bytes.
The external call in the modifier executes before the balance/allowance updates in the modified body, enabling reentrancy.
_from parameter drives allowance and balance debits.
_to parameter drives the balance credit.
_value parameter drives all arithmetic in transferFrom.
transferFrom performs raw subtraction/addition without SafeMath on Solidity 0.7.
Unchecked arithmetic mutates the balanceOf mapping.
Unchecked arithmetic mutates the allowance mapping.
msg.sender determines whose allowance is spent in transferFrom.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
approve stores allowance keyed by msg.sender.
Constructor writes the privileged owner state variable.
Constructor stores the computed swap pair.
Constructor calls pairFor to derive uniPair.
pairFor hashes the wETH token address.
tokenA parameter feeds the pair hash.
tokenB parameter feeds the pair hash.
BotProtected constructor sets the botProtection address used for privileged calls.
_botProtection argument assigned to botProtection state variable.
ArcxToken.transfer routes to transferFrom(msg.sender,...).
delegate executes the arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target.
Parameter b is the delegatecall payload.
delegate uses msg.sender in the owner require check.
Owner state variable is compared against msg.sender to gate delegate.
Arbitrary delegatecall can overwrite owner storage and hijack access control.
list performs the addLiquidityETH external call.
The external call targets the uniRouter state variable.
list derives the swapping deadline from block.timestamp.
block.timestamp-derived deadline is passed into addLiquidityETH.
list is restricted by a msg.sender == owner require.
Owner state variable gates the list function.
_numList parameter used for the contract balance and liquidity amount.
list rewrites balanceOf entries including the contract and owner balances.
list computes the owner allocation from the totalSupply state variable.
ERC20.transfer delegates to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates to _approve.
ERC20.approve delegates to _approve.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
_mint uses SafeMath.add for supply and balance.
_burn uses SafeMath.sub for balance and supply.
_transfer writes the _balances mapping.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
